description: LLM Council works together to answer your hardest questions

summary.one_liner: A local, ChatGPT-style web app that sends one query to several LLMs via OpenRouter, has them anonymously rank each other's answers, and then has a chairman model write a final synthesized response.
summary.what_it_does: The app takes a user question and sends it to every model in a configured council. Stage 1 collects each model's individual response, which the UI shows in a tab view so each can be inspected. Stage 2 gives each model the other responses with model identities anonymized, and asks it to rank them for accuracy and insight. Stage 3 has a designated Chairman model compile all responses and rankings into one final answer. The backend is FastAPI and the frontend is React with Vite, and conversations are stored as JSON files in data/conversations/. Council members and the chairman are set in backend/config.py.
use_cases: compare answers from several LLMs side by side
get a synthesized answer from multiple models
cross-check LLM responses against each other
explore which LLM gives the best answers to a hard question
use multiple models while reading books together
how_to_run: Create a .env file in the project root with OPENROUTER_API_KEY=your key
Optionally edit backend/config.py to set COUNCIL_MODELS and CHAIRMAN_MODEL
./start.sh (or run 'uv run python -m backend.main' for the backend and 'npm run dev' in frontend/ for the frontend)
Open the frontend URL in your browser
notable: Anonymized peer review: models rank each other's responses without knowing which model wrote them
Three-stage pipeline: individual answers, peer ranking, then chairman synthesis
Uses OpenRouter so one API key reaches many LLM providers
Simple local setup with JSON file storage and no database
caveats: The author states the project is provided as-is and will not be supported or improved
Requires an OpenRouter API key and purchased or topped-up credits
Described as a simple local app; no hosted deployment is mentioned
keywords: run several ai models at once
